input.quote: This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for three years unless earlier terminated in accordance with its terms.
input.rationale: The term is three years and the termination provisions (Sections 9.1–9.5) give only for-cause, insolvency and performance-failure rights; there is no Customer termination for convenience, and Section 2.1 states the commitment carries no termination rights. No Customer convenience right in a multi-year term is walk-away, so we have inserted a 30 days' notice right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and confirmed Vendor has no convenience right mid-term.

input.quote: Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Renewals are 12 months with a 30-day opt-out available to us only, a 60-day Vendor reminder (with the deadline extended if the reminder is missed), and uplifts capped at the lesser of CPI and 3% on 90 days' notice — this meets our preferred position in full.

input.quote: This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Singapore law with exclusive Singapore venue is outside our accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and directly contradicts Section 28.2, which already gives exclusive jurisdiction to the New York County courts. We have conformed Section 28.1 to New York law and New York County courts.

input.quote: Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position: free assignment by us to Affiliates and successors, Vendor assignment (including by change of control) only with our consent and never to a competitor, and Section 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any termination, suspension or repricing right on our change of control.
